description: (Na)₂ScCuCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a ScCuCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the ScCuCl₆ framework, Sc is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form ScCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CuCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sc-Cl bond lengths are 2.49 Å. Cu is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form CuCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cu-Cl bond lengths are 2.50 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Sc and one Cu atom.
